svg.title: Nobs Avionics wiring diagram
svg.text: 4 push buttons · 2 encoders · 6 (ON)-OFF-(ON) momentary toggles · status LED
FRONT VIEW · USB UP · ANALOG HEADER ON THE LEFT
• Pins chosen for the shortest wires: buttons and encoders on the analog header, toggles and LED on the digital header, ordered so no wires cross.
• LED is on D1 (D4 is taken by T5); it blinks for up to 30 s while waiting for USB. D13 is the one spare pin. Toggle lever UP closes the lug opposite the
lever: swap UP/DN in firmware if reversed.
